description:
Reports across New Jersey show more coordinated nighttime drone activity, with claims they’re flying in patterns or watching homes. Online videos fuel speculation about foreign countries like Iran or even aliens piloting them, and officials still can’t explain it. Investigators and experts say the flight behavior is unusual, but even with increased patrols, they still can’t figure out who’s controlling the drones, leaving people uneasy and divided.

description:
Mother Nature shows how powerful it can be across remote homesteads, where extreme weather and tough locations make survival really hard. From devastating wildfires in Paradise, California to powerful tornadoes, storms, and feral hogs in East Texas, flooding in the southern swamps of central Florida that brings alligators, and brutal winter conditions in Alaska, these moments show how unpredictable life off the grid can be.
